title: PaymentOrder
description: Single payment order response body from GET /api/merchants/{merchantId}/payment-orders/{paymentOrderId}. Required fields are the stable, always-present contract fields. Lifecycle timestamps and amounts are optional/nullable — they are null for orders that have not yet reached the corresponding lifecycle state.

amountMinor.description: Total order amount in the currency's minor unit (e.g. cents, grosze)

status.description: Lifecycle status: CREATED | AUTHORIZED | CAPTURED | CANCELLED | REFUNDED

capturedAmountMinor.description: Amount captured in minor units; null until CAPTURED

refundedAmountMinor.description: Amount refunded in minor units; null until REFUNDED

authorizedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant when the order was authorized; null until AUTHORIZED

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 instant when the authorization expires; null until AUTHORIZED

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant when the order was captured; null until CAPTURED

cancelledAt.description: ISO-8601 instant when the order was cancelled; null until CANCELLED

refundedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant when the order was refunded; null until REFUNDED

metadata.description: Free-form metadata set via PATCH. Null until metadata is patched. May be a JSON object or null.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 instant when the order was created; always present

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant of the last update; always present

_note: additionalProperties: false catches field additions or renames in the backend response. If the backend adds a new field, this schema fails intentionally — review and extend the schema to accept it. Phase 8H.
